name: Manzanera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, blue and white with a broad blue stripe, charged at the hoist with the crowned arms of Manzanera (a tree and a castle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Manzanera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Manzanera arms — tree and castle on white
